process_guard: Unmodified larger_scorer_v09.server: 5.5 GiB hard AS, 7 GiB resident cgroup watchdog, 3600 CPU seconds, 1050 wall seconds per process.
preflight_policy: All inputs rendered and tokenized in one forward-pass-free process before either completion; exact prompt plus full 384-token reserve must fit 4096. No truncation or substitution.
cache_policy: One completion in each fresh process; cache_prompt=false. Require native timings.cache_n=0.
failure_policy: Stop at first execution/validation failure, preserve every response and failure; no retry, prompt repair, output repair, fallback, or changed parameter.
export_policy: Generated text and tokens remain external until a separate source-copy-budget review binds each response content hash. Initial project receipts contain no source, prompt, response text, or generated token IDs.
